. Since >x< launched, our little bird app has become one of the most talked about social platforms. From memes to events to breaking news –– >x< is where it’s happening and where people are talking about it. Along with a prime spot in the pop culture lexicon, we are prey to some misconceptions about what we do and how we do it. So let’s break down the common questions and comments we get and talk a little about what is fact vs. myth.
Does >x< shadow ban?

Let’s discuss this one upfront. Simply put, we don’t shadow ban! Ever. We do rank posts to create a more relevant experience for you, however, and you’re always able to see posts from people you follow. Check out our company
